### **Column Description: `LISTING_STATUS`**
**Table:** `RENTAL_INFORMATION`

| **Attribute**       | **Description**                                                                 |

| **Description**      | Indicates the current status of a rental property listing in the system.      |
| **Allowed Values**   | - `ACTIVE` *(Listing is available for rent)*                                  |
|                      | - `INACTIVE` *(Listing is temporarily unavailable)*                         |
|                      | - `RENTED` *(Property is currently occupied)*                                |
|                      | - `PENDING` *(Listing is under review or awaiting approval)*                 |
|                      | - `SUSPENDED` *(Listing violated policies and is disabled)*                  |
|                      | - `DELETED` *(Listing was removed by the owner/admin)*                       |
| **Constraints**      | `CHECK (LISTING_STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'RENTED', 'PENDING', 'SUSPENDED', 'DELETED'))` |
| **Example**          | `ACTIVE` *(A listing ready for tenant applications)*                         |
| **Business Rules**   | - Only admins/owners can change the status.                                  |
|                      | - `RENTED` status is set automatically when a lease is signed.                |
